fix.notes: The fix covers all three person sub-pages (main, achievements, matches) for consistency, not just the main one as hinted in triage. Persons without an mtgo_username continue to work via ID URLs as noted in the issue's own comment. The archetype redirect preserves deck_type (tournament/league) from the original URL.
fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong

`/people/id/{person_id}/`, `/people/id/{person_id}/achievements/`, `/people/id/{person_id}/matches/`, and `/archetypes/{numeric_id}/` all served content directly without redirecting to the canonical vanity URL. This meant search engines and clients could index/cache the ID-based URLs instead of the human-readable ones, and the site had to load extra data even when a vanity URL was available.

## What changed

- **`decksite/controllers/people.py`**: Added `request` to imports. In `person()`, `person_achievements()`, and `person_matches()`, after loading the person by `person_id`, if `p.mtgo_username is not None`, issue a 301 redirect to the equivalent vanity (`mtgo_username`) URL using `request.endpoint` so it works for both the main app and season-prefixed blueprints. Users without an MTGO username (Goldfish/Tapped Out only) continue to be served via the ID URL as noted in the issue comments.
- **`decksite/controllers/metagame.py`**: In `archetype()`, after loading the archetype, if `archetype_id.isdigit()`, issue a 301 redirect to the name-based URL (spaces replaced with `+` to match existing URL conventions), preserving `deck_type`.

## Validation

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed on all touched files
- `uv run --frozen python dev.py unit` — 848 passed, 1 skipped (pre-existing skip), 0 failures

Fixes #7729
fix.pr_title: 301 redirect /x/{id} URLs to vanity URLs for person and archetype (#7729)

evidence.detail: person() handles both /people/<mtgo_username>/ and /people/id/<int:person_id>/ routes but never redirects from the ID-based route to the vanity URL
archetype() serves content for numeric archetype_id without redirecting to the name-based URL; load_archetype at data/archetype.py:28-39 distinguishes int vs string inputs
load_person() already fetches the mtgo_username via ps.load_person_by_id, making the redirect straightforward for users who have one

triage.fix_sketch: In decksite/controllers/people.py person(): after loading p when called with person_id and p.mtgo_username is not None, return redirect(url_for('.person', mtgo_username=p.mtgo_username), code=301). In decksite/controllers/metagame.py archetype(): after loading a, if archetype_id.isdigit() return redirect(url_for('.archetype', archetype_id=a.name.replace(' ', '+')), code=301). Each change is 3-5 lines.
triage.notes: Issue comment flags that Goldfish/Tapped-Out-only users have no vanity URL to redirect to; the fix handles this gracefully by only redirecting when mtgo_username is present. Archetypes always have names so no edge case there.
